senses.definition_en: Having relatively low economic, industrial, or technological development.
senses.definition_ar: غير متطور أو نامٍ اقتصاديًا وصناعيًا.
examples: Aid was sent to underdeveloped countries to help rebuild infrastructure.

senses.definition_en: Not normally or fully grown, formed, or developed.
senses.definition_ar: غير مكتمل النمو جسديًا أو فكريًا.
examples: Chronic malnutrition led to an underdeveloped immune system.
The main plot of the movie felt underdeveloped and rushed.
